{{Quote|Those Imperials are causing trouble again. Some of their bucketheads had a firefight that damaged a load of ships, and a poor droid leaked oil everywhere.|Elis Helrot|<ref name="BH">''[[Bounty Hunt]]''</ref>}}
'''Elis Helrot''' was a [[Givin]] who worked as a [[pilot]] and [[spice]] [[smuggler]]. He spoke with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] about the fugitive [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[astromech droid]] [[261]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]]. Helrot was later present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] got into an altercation with the thugs [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]].

==Biography==
===Rogue droid witness===
[[File:ElrotBossk-BountyHunt.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Elis Helrot spoke to Bossk in Mos Eisley.]]
Elis Helrot was a [[Givin]] who worked as a [[pilot]] and a [[smuggler]] of [[spice]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CL 2016" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">{{BountyHuntDate}}</ref> he<ref name="Topps" /> was in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the rogue Imperial [[astromech droid]] [[261]] crashed its [[Thief|stolen]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] in one of the port's [[hangar]] bays after escaping from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]] with sensitive Imperial files.<ref name="BH" />

Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s then engaged the [[droid]] in a firefight and managed to damage it, but 261 escaped while leaking [[oil]]. When the [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] arrived in Mos Eisley in search of 261 a short while later, he spoke with Helrot in one of the spaceport's buildings about the events of the crash.<ref name="BH" />

===Cantina customer===
[[File:Greedo_Helrot_and_de_Maal.png|thumb|right|300px|Helrot sat with De Maal in the cantina.|250px]]
Later that year,<ref name="Galactic Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1|the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] sequence}} [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] depicts Elis Helrot as being present for this sequence.</ref> Helrot sat at a booth table with the [[Gotal]] [[Feltipern Trevagg]] and the [[H'nemthe (species)|H'nemthe]] [[M'iiyoom Onith]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in Mos Eisley when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|his lightsaber]] to fend off the thugs [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]] at the [[cantina]]'s bar.<ref name="CL 2016" />

Helrot was then joined at the table by the [[Duros]] [[Ohwun De Maal]], and the pair were speaking when the [[Rodian]] [[bounty]] hunter [[Greedo]] cornered the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] in one of the cantina's booths behind Helrot's back. Solo then shot and [[Death|killed]] Greedo and left the cantina, briefly drawing the attention of the other customers.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Elis Helrot had [[Color|white]] skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="CL 2016" /> The Givin spoke disparagingly of Imperial stormtroopers to the [[bounty]] hunter Bossk<ref name="BH" /> and had little use for them, but respected their raw power and did his best to avoid entanglements with them.<ref name="Topps" />

==Skills and abilities==
Helrot had average intelligence and speed, with just below average fighting ability and strength. He had poor diplomatic skills and was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
Elis Helrot wore a black shirt with a white [[Clothing|shawl]] while in Mos Eisley.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
===''A New Hope'' concept alien===
{{Quote|Another booth-based reshoot alien, this walking skeleton with the anguished face was based on original illustrations by Ralph McQuarrie. It was nicknamed 'Skull Head,' and was to have the proper name of Kull.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]], discussing the creation of Elis Helrot|<ref name="Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>}}
[[File:Givin_McQuarrie_Concept.png|thumb|left|250px|Helrot was based on art drawn by Ralph McQuarrie]]
The character who would eventually become known as Elis Helrot<ref name="CL 2016" /> first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character was portrayed on set by special effects artist [[Jon Berg]],<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2012/10/star-wars-at-35-celebrating-cantina.html|name=STAR WARS AFICIONADO|text=STAR WARS AT 35: CELEBRATING THE CANTINA CREATURES|date=2012-10-03}}</ref> who wore a rubber mask he had created based on a piece of concept art drawn by concept artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]] in [[1976]].<ref name="McQuarrie">''[[Star Wars Art: Ralph McQuarrie]]''</ref> Helrot was originally known by the nickname "Skull Head,"<ref name="Aliases" /> and also refered to as "Skull Guy,"<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref> and was to officially be named "Kull," but that plan never came to fruition.<ref name="Aliases" />

During post-production shooting of supplemental footage for the cantina sequence<ref name="Beastmaster">{{InsiderCite|126|The Beastmaster!}}</ref> on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]] and [[January 25|25]], 1977,<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Berg sat in a booth with two [[alien]]s who would later be named M'iiyoom Onith and Feltipern Trevagg.<ref name="CL 2016" /><ref name="Databank">{{DB|species|givin|Givin}}</ref> Footage of Helrot with these characters did not make it into the final cut of the film, although Helrot is visible in another scene in the cantina.<ref name="ANH" />

===Naming===
[[File:ElisHelrotMask.png|thumb|right|250px|Elis Helrot's mask was created by Jon Berg.]]
The character first received the name Elis Helrot in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] through the [[1995]] ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]]<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Elis Helrot}}</ref> The 2016 reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] officially established Helrot's name and presence at the Mos Eisley Cantina table alongside Onith and Trevagg.<ref name="CL 2016" />
